footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Medical Properties Trust: after $1.1M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 2.4% to $972M in 2025. Operating income was $348M, up from a $964M loss.
The net loss narrowed to $277M, or −$0.46 per share, from $2.4B. Operating cash flow was $231M and free cash flow $231M, versus $245M; Medical Properties Trust returned $23.4M through buybacks.
